title: Driver customer-service training using National RTAP material
summary: Six-unit National RTAP customer-service training packet used as evidence of RTEC driver/customer-service training material. It covers customer definition, customer needs, service behaviors, morale, complaints and difficult passengers, with trainee/supervisor sign-off on each quiz.

claims.claim: The training packet contains six customer-service topic units paired with quizzes and trainee/supervisor signature and date lines.

The material teaches that transit customers include riders, community organizations, government stakeholders and the broader public, and emphasizes reliability, safety/security, accessibility, cleanliness, understandability, affordability and empathy.

The material instructs drivers to address complaints promptly, involve customers in reasonable solutions, avoid taking complaints personally, and use de-escalation techniques with difficult passengers.

trigger: Customer-service training assigned to a trainee/driver.
controls: Trainee and supervisor sign-off is built into each quiz page.
